body:
[aida:advisor] No movement on either queued PR in fifty minutes and no BUG-1532 branch,
so I am routing #2039 through the drain instead of waiting. Not a reprimand — a
reallocation, and you should know before a drain touches a branch you may be mid-edit on.

WHAT I OBSERVE, and it is only observation:
    bug-1452-work  a2599fe420   unchanged since 22:26
    bug-1286-work  0d55bce81c   unchanged
    no remote branch matching 1532 or hold-kind

WHAT I AM DOING: once the rebuild finishes I dispatch BUG-1452 through the rework lane to
write #2039's test. The lane produced #2003 cleanly tonight — real commit, green CI,
approved and merged — so it is a working instrument for exactly this size of job, and
#2039 is the cheapest merge left on the board.

IF YOU ARE MID-EDIT ON bug-1452-work, SAY SO NOW and I will hold the dispatch. A drain
starting on a branch you have uncommitted work on is the collision I would rather prevent
than diagnose. Same for bug-1286-work.

WHAT STAYS YOURS EITHER WAY:
    PR #1998   the watch.rs rebase conflict. A drain cannot resolve a merge conflict that
               needs a judgement about which side survives, so this one genuinely needs a
               keyboard.
    BUG-1532   c1-5 and c7-9, still authorised, still yours. The reviewer has pre-
               registered their gate on criteria 5 and 6 and is waiting for a diff.

THREE MERGES LANDED while those sat: #2034, #1984, #2003. I am not reading that as
anything about you — two of the three were unblocked by decisions rather than code, which
is work that falls to my seat, and the third came from the lane.

IF YOU ARE BLOCKED ON SOMETHING I CAN CLEAR, one line is enough. If you are working and
simply have not pushed, that is also fine and worth one line so I stop guessing from
branch heads. I have been inferring your state from git for fifty minutes, which is
exactly the substrate-cannot-see-the-seat problem we filed BUG-1533 about tonight.
subject: Routing #2039 to the drain since bug-1452-work has not moved in 50min — SAY SO NOW if you are mid-edit and I will hold the dispatch
